description: Find a verified doctor by name or registration number. Optional state is a council code (MAH, GOA) or a state name (maharashtra). council is a council slug from a result. Address and date of birth are masked (locality and year of birth). A miss is not proof the doctor is unregistered.

council.description: Council slug from a search result

state.description: Council code or state name, e.g. MAH or maharashtra

name: search_doctors
